name: ABA Attorney Ethics Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for US attorney-client confidentiality when work product is submitted to AI systems (ABA Model Rule 1.6, ABA Formal Opinion 512, D.C. Bar Opinion 388). Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

What it enforces: ordinary personal data becomes matter-identifying inside a legal document, so it must arbitrate ahead of the legal signals it accompanies rather than behind them. A Social Security number in a filing identifies a party directly (critical, top of the ladder); an EIN links a corporate party to public filings; an email address identifies counsel or client; a phone number identifies contacting parties. The legal category's own sequencing lives in the legal theme — this overlay only relocates the attorney-context escalation of NON-legal data (D17 T0 §3, D-1).

Pair with: the legal and pii themes. California practitioners add the cal-bar-ethics overlay on top; that overlay declares a profile dependency on this one, so the engine rejects a configuration that takes CA's stricter rules without the ABA baseline.

Scope: US attorney-client confidentiality — overrides only

overrides.reason: SSN in a legal document identifies a party, client or witness directly — always critical, arbitrates first
EIN identifies corporate entities and links to public filings
Email addresses identify attorneys, clients and opposing parties
US phone numbers identify contacting parties
